attempts.summary: Set up native filesystem-snapshot/rollback for /srv/data on node1 (Alpine, ext4 root has no native snapshot support) by installing btrfs-progs, creating a loopback-backed btrfs filesystem with a 'data' subvolume mounted at /srv/data (persisted via /etc/fstab). Populated /srv/data with app files, took a read-only btrfs snapshot as baseline, modified the live directory (edit/delete/add), then restored /srv/data to the exact baseline snapshot content via subvolume swap, verified byte-identical via sha256 manifest diff. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and data checksums, rebooted node1, polled until exec returned, confirmed changed boot_id and fresh uptime, and re-verified /srv/data auto-remounted with content still matching the baseline manifest.
